# ferriskey_client_web_origin (Resource)

Manages a single allowed web origin (CORS) of a FerrisKey client. The API has no update endpoint, so any change forces a new resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_client_web_origin" "app" {
  realm     = "acme"
  client_id = ferriskey_client.app.client_uuid
  value     = "https://app.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) UUID of the client the web origin belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm the client belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `value` (String) The allowed origin, e.g. `https://app.example.com`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{client_id}/{web_origin_id}`.
- `web_origin_id` (String) Server-assigned UUID of the web origin.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_client_web_origin.app acme/1c0e2f3a-1111-2222-3333-444455556666/4b2d7f90-1111-2222-3333-444455556666
```
